title: Hāna Health Center land change for housing
summary: On December 17, 2024, the commission voted five in favor to recommend approving the change of Hāna Health Center land from the state agriculture district to the rural district. The approval carries the department's two conditions plus priority for Hāna residents in the housing where practical. The change would allow six workforce housing units and a specialty clinic, and the project must still return to the state land board for final approval.
